parse.title: Falador Diary
parse.wikitext:
==Medium==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Falador" data-diary-tier="Medium"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Light a [[Bullseye lantern]] at the [[Chemist|Chemist's]] in [[Rimmington]].
|
*{{SCP|Firemaking|49|link=yes}}
*[[Tinderbox]] and a regular [[bullseye lantern]]
|-
|2. [[Telegrab]] some [[Wine of Zamorak]] at the [[Chaos Temple (Asgarnia)|Chaos Temple]] by the [[Wilderness]].
''Note: This altar is located north-west of the [[Goblin Village]]. You have to be inside the building until the jug appears in your inventory for the task to register as completed.''
|
*{{SCP|Magic|33|link=yes}}
*Means to cast [[Telegrab]] ({{RuneReq|Air=1|Law=1}})
|-
|3. Unlock the [[Crystal chest]] in [[Taverley]].
|
*[[Crystal key]]
|-
|4. Place a [[Scarecrow]] in the [[Falador farm]] flower patch.
|
*{{SCP|Farming|23|link=yes}} ([[Ironman mode|Ironman accounts]] require {{SCP|Farming|47|link=yes}} or the ability to kill [[gryphon]]s)
*[[Bronze spear]], [[watermelon]], and a [[hay sack]] (you can fill an [[empty sack]] with hay at the [[hay bale]] in the chicken coop nearby.)
|-
|5. Kill a [[Mogre]] at [[Mudskipper Point]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Skippy and the Mogres]]
*{{SCP|Slayer|32|link=yes}}
*[[Fishing explosive]]. 
* It is not possible to skip having to complete Skippy and the Mogres, or needing a fishing explosive, by killing them through a boat cannon through the Sailing skill.
|-
|6. Visit the [[Port Sarim]] [[Rat Pits]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Ratcatchers]]
|-
|7. Grapple up and then jump off the north [[Falador]] wall.
|
*{{SCP|Agility|11|link=yes}}, {{SCP|Strength|37|link=yes}}, and {{SCP|Ranged|19|link=yes}}
*[[Mith grapple]]{{efn|[[Ironman Mode|Ironmen]] require either access to the [[Ancient Cavern]] or 59 [[Smithing]] and 59 [[Fletching]] for a [[mith grapple]].}} and any [[Crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]]
|-
|8. Pickpocket a [[Falador]] [[guard]].
|
*{{SCP|Thieving|40|link=yes}}
|-
|9. Pray at the [[Stone circle|Altar of Guthix]] in [[Taverley]] whilst wearing full [[Initiate armour|Initiate]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Recruitment Drive]]
*{{SCP|Prayer|10|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Defence|20|link=yes}}
*[[Initiate armour]]
|-
|10. Mine some [[Gold ore]] at the [[Crafting Guild]].
|
*{{SCP|Crafting|40|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Mining|40|link=yes}}
*Any [[pickaxe]] and a [[brown apron]], [[golden apron]], or [[Crafting cape]]
|-
|11. Squeeze through the crevice in the [[Dwarven mine]]s.
|
*{{SCP|Agility|42|link=yes}}
|-
|12. Chop and burn some [[Willow logs]] in [[Taverley]].
''Note: Willow trees can be found to the south-east along the lake. [[Willow tree (Farming)|Player-grown willow trees]] do not count towards completing the task.''
|
*{{SCP|Woodcutting|30|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Firemaking|30|link=yes}}
*Any [[axe]] and a [[tinderbox]]
|-
|13. Craft a [[basket|fruit basket]] on the [[Falador Farm]] [[loom]].
|
*{{SCP|Crafting|36|link=yes}} (and {{SCP|Farming|30|link=yes}} for [[Ironman mode|Ironman accounts]])
*6 [[Willow branch]]es
|-
|14. Teleport to [[Falador]].
|
*{{SCP|Magic|37|link=yes}}
*Means to cast [[Falador Teleport]] ({{RuneReq|Air=3|Water=1|Law=1}})
|}
{{Notelist}}

===Rewards===
*[[Falador shield 2]]:
**Can restore 50% of [[prayer points]] once a day
*[[Antique lamp (medium)|Antique lamp]] worth 7,500 experience in any skill of at least level 40
*10% more experience from the [[Falador farm|Falador farming patch]]
*Access to the [[Dark tunnel (Motherlode Mine)|dark tunnel shortcut]] in the [[Motherlode Mine]] (with 54 [[Agility]]) 
*Roughly 21% increased chance of receiving a [[clue scroll (medium)|medium clue scroll]] from a [[guard]] in [[Falador]] (from 1/128 to 1/106)
